question: Memory Snow was the best!! The cuteness of the girls, and Subaru's annoyingness, and Puck's faces, and all of it were so entertaining, it reminded me of the anime two years ago! Thank you very much for the wonderful OVA!!!! As a question, in life after arc four, how did Garfiel interact with Clind and Annerose?
answer: Annerose was upset with him, calling him "An overly inquisitive person!", but he more or less treated her as though he was a mischievous older brother. As for Clind-san, thoughts of Garfiel's childhood are within his memory, so he was unusually admiring of Garfiel, but Garfiel, uncertain of Clind's actual strength, was wary of him.
